ratings_why.fun: Every turn asks whether to hold still or reposition, hoard Rest or spend it, and the Wake dominoes (Kurent, Prior, Parkelj, Ribica) overlap in ways the builds don't fully list.
ratings_why.distinct: A buff-doubling counter that turns into an event when it hits zero is fresh, though the hold-still pressure echoes Hedgerow folk's turns-in-slot clocks.

verdict_why: The engine is strong and should stay hot; a couple of Wake timing questions need settling before the dominoes can be read.

points.text: Echo Nave Choir makes Wake texts fire twice, but Pool Olmling's Wake is 'once a turn'. Say whether the Choir's second firing counts against that limit.
Wake chains need a stated order: when Cowbell Kurent's +2/+2 empties a neighbour's Rest mid-resolution, does that Wake resolve at once or after the current one? Prior and Ribica counts depend on it.
The Robber-Knight doubles as a mass Wake trigger in fights, feeding Ribica's 12. Name that in its text or the Wake build, since it's the best off-purpose use in the tribe.
Parkelj the Dark could also drain Rest the Robber-Knight lent to the enemy, making the awake olm a bridge between the two builds rather than only an anti-synergy.
Hanging Horseshoe Bat losing Hunker when the Dragon floods is a nice tension; a version that Wakes into something (Wake: gain Shield) would make it pay in both builds.

standouts.why: Parkelj eats the hoard and sets off the Wake build at once: one card that reads differently in every board.
The Robber-Knight turns a buff resource into an enemy debuff, and as a side effect wakes your whole board mid-fight.
The Eldest silently switches off buff Wakes, so taking it is a real fork in the road, not just a bigger number.

weakest.why: Dormouse Pilgrim is a plain gold-for-not-moving card that stacks without any combo hook.
Lamplighter Hrošč is a generic buffer; it works with Rest but adds no new decision.
Vespers Bat is pure setup with no payoff of its own, though the Wake build needs it.

flags.note: Dark-Sensing Olm has no cap, and with The Eldest and Cloister Keeper the Rest beside it only climbs, so its Attack grows without limit.
The Eldest doubling every permanent gain forever with another tribe's share-based growth (an Ooze eating doubled units) may compound.
Mother Ribica copies plus Choir-doubled Wakes may give a golden of your biggest unit every turn or two.
Interaction with 'once a turn' Wake limits is not stated.
